selection_rule: Exact fastest/cheapest certificates, then full DP if it fits, then exact feasible-time corridor DP if it fits, otherwise bounded dual A*.
scope: Static estimated length plus arrival-node exposure objective, discrete time budget; no physical rescue/hardware superiority claim.
timing: Cold full API call including quantization, preprocessing and allocation; compilation/import warmup excluded; HiGHS time limit 3 seconds.
confidence_interval: 3000 map-seed cluster bootstrap samples, RNG 802913; speed only mutually proven-optimal feasible pairs.
memory_scope: Numeric scratch only; host Python heap/graph temporaries and native HiGHS/reference process memory excluded.
